remarks: Charming Studio in Downtown Stamford - Ideal Location & Investment Opportunity! Looking for the perfect studio in the heart of downtown Stamford? This well-maintained unit offers both comfort and convenience, located just a short walk from all the amenities the vibrant downtown area has to offer. Whether you're looking to own your first home or seeking an excellent investment opportunity(heat & hot water included in monthly HOA), this studio has it all! Features: New wall to wall carpet and freshly painted interiors for a modern and inviting feel. Located in a small, quiet complex with only 16 units, offering a cozy and private atmosphere. No rental restrictions, making it an ideal option for investors seeking long-term rentals or short-term leasing. Washer/dryer in the building for added convenience. Storage space available for your extra belongings. Prime location within walking distance to shops, restaurants, public transportation, and entertainment. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to own or invest in one of downtown Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods!
